bio: An informal place to eat in the centre of Mahón? Opposite the always-busy Mercat des Peix, you'll find a place where they offer good Mediterranean market cuisine with interesting international touches. In this simple bistro, which also has a tapas bar called Augustin (they share the terrace), you can try dishes like escarole buñuelos, a reinterpretation of the typical Raoles, or the unctuous Cannelé with hazelnut praline chantilly. Indulge in the daily recommendations!...
